leadStory: Mohamed Salah has passed his medical and is unveiled at Trabzonspor tonight on a two-year deal, ending nine years at Anfield, while Iraola weighs a double raid on PSG (Barcola and the offered Illia Zabarnyi) and the defence thins to one fit senior right-back after Frimpong's Leeds overload and Gomez's month out.
subject: AS Monaco visit Anfield on Sunday for Andoni Iraola's first home game in charge, the first football back at Anfield this pre-season
